Commentary.Commentary: So that concludes the long tour of England in India. The hosts dominated the Test series and won it 4-0! The ODIs were a different story as it was an evenly fought contest which again was won by the home side 2-1! Then came the T20Is which went down to the wire after being leveled at 1-1. The Indians saved the best for the last and won the T20I series as well. England would be disappointed with the series loss but would look to take the positives from it going on to West Indies for an ODI series which will start on 3rd of March. India on the other hand, full of confidence, will be playing Bangladesh for a one-off Test in Hyderabad on 9th February. Until then, take care! Cheers!

Indian Skipper, Virat Kohli says that it had been a long time since he played in Bangalore and it was the perfect time to play here. Adds that it is a pleasure to have Dhoni always there behind him and also acknowledges the insights from the seniors like Nehra and Yuvraj. Believes that Yuvraj was the difference when he scored 24 runs off the Jordan over. Applauds the brilliance of Chahal and Mishra in getting the wickets when it mattered the most. Encourages the fact that Chahal has been brilliant throughout and it feels really good as he is always up for the challenge whenever given the ball. Says that Dhoni is brilliant at any number and he wanted to give him the leverage of coming up the order. Ends by saying that it was brilliant to win in all the formats of the game and will hope to carry the form in the upcoming series.

Man of the Match and Man of the Series, Yuzvendra Chahal says that he felt really nice to play in Bengaluru in the Indian jersey. On being asked about being asked to bowl in the Powerplay, he said that he has done that previously in the Indian domestics and feels confident of bowling in it. Also appreciates his skipper by saying that he has a lot of confidence in him and always backs him up. Also thanks Dhoni for helping him on what to bowl as the batsmen always look to hit the spinners in T20s. Lauds Mishra's performance and for giving him good support out in the middle. Ends by saying that he never dreamt of picking up a 6-fer!

England Skipper, Eoin Morgan says that they could not capitalise when they had two set batsmen in the middle and then there was a beautiful performance by Chahal which totally outdid them. Adds that he or Root should have got around 70 odd runs to make the chase a bit easier. Feels that if they were given a total of 190 before the game started they would have surely taken it. Opines that he is really happy with his team's bowling efforts as well with the batting performances. Applauds the Indian team for playing beautiful cricket throughout and winning the series.

Yuzvendra Chahal was the hero of the match as he started the collapse and ended with the figures of 4-0-25-6! The best ever-figures by an Indian bowler in T20Is. He would be relieved that he put on such a performance with the ball as he missed out a simple chance of running out Roy earlier in the match. Amit Mishra supported him well as he kept it really tight, conceding just 23 runs in his 4 overs. Nehra and Pandya had a decent outing with the ball whereas Bumrah continued his good work from the last match, picking up 3 wickets at the back end of the innings.

The pressure then got the better off the visiting side as Morgan and Root departed in back-to-back deliveries. It was a horrendous performance from thereon as they lost 8 wickets for 8 runs in the space of 18 deliveries. Buttler who got promoted above Stokes once again failed while Stokes and Ali too couldn't do anything as they had a daunting task ahead of them.

Jason Roy and Joe Root then steadied the ship. They stitched a 47-run partnership in just 29 deliveries for the second wicket. Roy then fell to Mishra. But, that didn't worry England as once again their skipper came out in the middle and kept the runs ticking, keeping them in the hunt. He and Root together put up 64 runs in 43 balls. However, then started the collapse as a tight over from Mishra led England needing 86 off 42 deliveries.

The Men in Blue have done it again, they win the T20I series 2-1! They beat England in the Tests, in the ODIs and now in the T20Is. In the series decider, a great collective batting performance from the hosts set a huge target in front of the visitors. They started with the ball in a great fashion too as they sent Billings packing for a golden duck.

OUT! Edged and taken! Full and wide outside off, Mills slashes hard but only gets a thick outside edge which goes through the slip cordon. Virat Kohli has stationed himself at wide first slip but does well to get across to his left to take a good catch. INDIA WIN BY 75 RUNS BY BOWLING OUT ENGLAND UNDER 17 OVERS!
The batsman tries hooking that one but misses it completely.
TYMAL MILLS is the last man in.
OUT! BOWLED! Ohh... that smirk from Bumrah. As if it is normal business. A length ball outside off, Plunkett backs away to pull but misses. The ball comes back in and hits the top of off stump.
ADIL RASHID walks in at number 10, replacing Jordan.
OUT! STUMPED! Easily done. Floated outside off, Jordan comes down the track but is beaten in flight. He misses, Dhoni doesn't. Chahal finishes with 6/25 in 4 overs.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
CHRIS JORDAN walks in at number 9, replacing Stokes.

OUT! Terrific catch under pressure! A short ball on middle, Stokes rocks back to pull, aiming to clear mid-wicket but he does not have the elevation. It is a flat hit but powerful. Suresh Raina stands as cool as a cucumber near the ropes and takes the catch calmly with a leap. But then, he loses balance and almost crosses the ropes. Nope, he recovers, keeps himself inside the boundary and then gets back to celebrate. The umpires check upstairs for the legality and replays confirm the same. CHAHAL BECOMES THE FIRST INDIAN BOWLER TO TAKE A 5-WICKET HAUL IN T20IS.
Raina has taken a terrific catch! But has he touched the ropes? Referred upstairs. The soft signal is out...
FOUR! BANG! Silences the crowd. Jumps down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and blasts it straight back over the bowler for a boundary through long on!
Quicker one outside off, Stokes looks to cut but misses.
LIAM PLUNKETT walks in at number 8, replacing Moeen.

OUT! Wicket number 4 for Chahal! He is on a roll and spinning India to victory. Floated on middle and off, Moeen comes down the track and looks to go over the top but miscues it. The ball goes high in the air and Virat Kohli comes charging in from long on. Shoos everyone away, clearly indicating that it is his catch. Takes it cleanly.
Full and wide outside off, pushed through point for another single. Suresh Raina has a shy at the striker's end but misses. 4 runs and a wicket from the over, Bumrah's figures read 2-0-14-1.
Down the leg side, worked through mid-wicket for one.
Short and down the leg side again, worked behind square leg for a run.
Down the leg side, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
MOEEN ALI walks in at number 7, replacing Buttler.

OUT! Caught! England losing their way quickly now. A short ball outside off, Buttler gets across to pull but gets a top edge due to the extra bounce. The ball goes straight up in the air and Virat Kohli takes a simple catch running to his right from mid off. The promotion of Buttler does not work for England and they now need 84 from 34 balls.
Landed around off, defended back to the bowler.
JASPRIT BUMRAH is back on. He has three overs left, so should bowl the 15th, 17th and the 19th.
Full and outside off, driven straight to short extra cover. Game-changing over. 2 runs and 2 wickets from it. Chahal has figures of 3-0-21-3!
Nothing special on the hat-trick ball, defended to the off side.
BEN STOKES eventually comes out at number 6, replacing Root. Hat-trick ball it will be that he faces.

OUT! LBW! Two in two for   Chahal! M.Chinnaswamy roars. This is the slider from Chahal, landing it outside off, Root gets across to play for the turn but is beaten by pace and lack of room. Is hit right in front and the umpire raises his finger on the appeal! That dropped catch does not count then.
Surprise from England. JOS BUTTLER has been sent ahead of Ben Stokes at number 5, replacing Morgan.

OUT! Taken this time! Chahal provides the breakthrough. Full and outside off, the googly, Morgan looks to play the slog sweep but since it is a wrong 'un, he has to reach out to play the shot. He ends up getting a top edge which is calmly taken by Rishabh Pant near deep mid-wicket. Chahal is pumped up. The 64-run stand has been broken in 43 balls.
Full and wide outside off, Root slaps it wide of long off for a run.
Short and outside off, slapped to sweeper cover for a single.
YUZVENDRA CHAHAL is back on.
Full and outside off, Root looks to play the reverse sweep but misses.
WIDE. Full and miles outside off, Root takes his bat away at the last moment.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Short and outside off, Root looks to cut but misses.

DROPPED! Miscommunication! Full and wide outside off, Root looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge which lobs towards short third man. Yuvraj Singh comes across to his right but then Rishabh Pant charges in too, from point and collides with the other. As a result, Yuvraj drops it. A run taken.
Full and outside off, Morgan looks to slog sweep but gets a thick inside edge which goes onto Dhoni's chest and deflects towards square leg. A run taken.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single. 22 from the over! 89 needed from 48 balls now.
Full and outside off, driven towards long off for a run.
SIX! AUDACIOUS! A short ball around middle, Morgan rocks back and pulls it way over square leg!
WIDE. Full and fired down the leg side, Eoin misses his paddle.
50-run stand comes up in 31 balls.

SIX! Another biggie! This was not cleanly hit though. Landed outside off, Morgan backs away to the leg side and looks to go inside out but skews it a bit. However, he has enough to clear the extra cover fence!
SIX! Lovely hit! Flighted on middle, Morgan comes down the track and lofts it way over long on! 104 more needed from 52 balls now. Morgan moves to 25 from 15 balls.
Full on middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Interesting. Kohli has thrown the ball to SURESH RAINA now.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and outside off, driven wide of mid off for a run.
Now Morgan comes down the track and eases it through mid on. The ball races away but Lokesh Rahul quickly gets across to his right and dives to save the boundary. Two runs taken.
Comes down the track, takes it on the full and drives it to long on. Root takes off for the second but Morgan sends him back as Hardik Pandya does really well bear the fence. Just a single then.
Excellent bowling, tosses this outside off, the googly, Root reaches out to sweep but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Full and down the leg side, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Mopping up going on!
Swing and a miss! Fullish delivery outside off, Root goes through with his big shot and ends up swinging in the air. 117 runs required off the last 10 overs!
Slower one outside off, Root once again walks ahead and works it to backward point.
SIX! Length delivery, Root uses his feet, walks down the track and heaves it over mid-wicket and a long way into the stands. Root moves onto 36 off 23 deliveries!
Length delivery, wide outside off, Morgan cuts it through cover-point. It's cut out in the deep and a single is taken!
On the hips, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, angling across, punched off the back foot through mid off for a single.
Worked with the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
Root dances down the track. Mishra fires in a wrong one on the pads, Root does well to work it through mid-wicket for a single.
On off, spinning in, driven to long on for a single.
Full outside off, driven through covers. The long of fielder runs to his right and cuts it out.
FOUR! Tossed up outside off, Morgan brings out his reverse sweep and gets it past first slip. Beats short third man all the way through to the boundary.
FOUR! Leg spinner outside off, spinning in, Eoin stays back and drives it through covers. Beats Pant in his dive at short covers and gets a boundary for it.
On the hips, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Another dot as Morgan stays in his crease and defends the length delivery.
Length delivery, angling away a touch, defended off the back foot.
Fullish outside off, mistimes his loft to long off. Gets a single for it.
On a length outside off, nips away after pitching. Root stays in his crease and looks to run it down but misses.
SIX! Fuller and angling in, Root shuffles a touch and flicks it handsomely over mid-wicket. Clears the fence easily! That looks so easy on the eyes!
HARDIK PANDYA is now into the attack!
Outside off, Morgan looks to cut it late but misses as it goes into Dhoni's gloves. What an over! Just a single and a wicket off it!
Root kneels down and sweeps it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
On the pads, Root misses his flick and gets rapped up on the pads.
Full outside off, punched to Kohli at covers.
The skipper, EOIN MORGAN walks in the middle!

OUT! MISHRA HAS HIS MAN! Tossed up wide outside off, Roy kneels down and goes after the wide delivery with a slog sweep. Gets a top edge instead and the ball balloons high in the air. Dhoni gets under it near the short leg region and collects it easily. The dangerman, Roy departs! End of a 47-run partnership!
Tossed up wide outside off, Roy reaches for it and drives it straight to Kohli at covers.
AMIT MISHRA has come for a bowl!
FOUR! Full outside off, Root bends his knees and lofts it over covers for a boundary. Top shot!
On the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery, Roy gets into the position early and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.

WHAT HAPPENED THERE! Short delivery, pulled through mid-wicket for a single. Pandya gets to his left, collects the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end and there's a sound as the ball goes past the stumps. The replays show that the ball clipped the stumps but the bails doesn't come off.
Swing and a miss! Root walks down the track and goes for a big heave. Misses it but still goes through with the follow-up!
Angling away, tapped to covers.
Wide! Slower one down the leg side, Root leaves it and a wide is signalled.
ASHISH NEHRA comes back into the attack!
Root walks down the track and flat-bats the short delivery down the ground. Pandya from mid on, goes to his left and dives to stop it.
FOUR! This time he has width to use it and gets it past the backward point fielder for a boundary. What a placement!
Punched off the back foot to point.
Angling into the stumps, played with the angle through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length outside off, Roy guides it into the ground to first slip.
FOUR! That's juts so easy! Fullish outside off, Jason lofts it on the up over mid off for a boundary!
JASPRIT BUMRAH is introduced into the attack!
Tossed up outside off, Roy looks to cut it but gets a bottom edge towards covers. Single taken1
Root works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full outside off, pushed through mid off for a single.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads.

Chance goes begging! Quicker one, slides it in, Roy charges down and gets surprised by it. Gets off an inside edge past the leg stump through to fine leg. Nehra from short fine leg chases and keeps it down to a brace.
FOUR! Once again Chahal concedes a boundary off his first delivery! Tossed up on middle and leg, Roy kneels and sweeps it over long leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Short delivery, pulled over mid-wicket for a boundary. 13 runs off it!
Angling away, played to point.
Length delivery angling across, Root looks to cut it but gets a bottom edge into the ground towards Raina at first slip.
FOUR! Superb placement! On a length outside off, Joe stays in his crease and places it through the gap between backward point and short third man for a boundary.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Lucky boundary! Shortish delivery, angling across, Roy looks to pull but gets it off the under edge past Dhoni for a boundary.
On the pads, flicked through long leg. Beats Nehra in his dive, Mishra chases but gets stuck as he puts in a dive. He does well to get back on his feet and save a run for his team. Three runs taken!
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

WHAT HAVE YOU DONE, CHAHAL? Zero match awareness from the leggie. Tossed up delivery that is driven through mid off. Kohli at short extra cover dives to his right and stops the ball. Roy from the bowler's end takes off but Root never leaves his ground and sends him back. After fielding, Kohli throws the ball at Chahal. He is not alert and instead of whipping the bails off he turns and throws it to the keeper's end. Dhoni doesn't even pick the ball and shouts on Chahal! Roy gets a reprieve! Will this hurt India?
JOE ROOT is the new man in!

OUT! BILLING BAGS A GOLDEN DUCK! Quicker one sliding in, Billings looks to play it across the line but yorks himself. The ball goes off the inside edge onto the boots and towards the right of Dhoni. Raina from first slip dives and grabs the ball. The umpire refers it upstairs. The replays confirm the edge and the that the catch is clean. Great start for India!
Catch appeal against Billings has been referred upstairs.
Leg bye! Sliding into the pads, Roy fails to flick and gets it off the pads on  the leg side for a leg bye.
SIX! Where did that come from! Tossed up on middle and off, Roy brings out his reverse slog. Slogs it over point for a maximum. Everyone is stunned!
YUZVENDRA CHAHAL to bowl from the other end!
Leg bye! On the pads, JR misses his flick. Gets it off the pads to short mid-wicket for a leg bye. Maiden over to start with by Nehra!
On the shorter side of the length, Roy looks to drag it but gets it off the inside edge onto the pads. Nehra appeals again but is turned down.
Fuller on the pads, Roy misses his flick and the ball goes off the boots behind. Dhoni dives to his left and stops it.
Back of a length delivery, angling across, guided into the ground and to the slip cordon.
Length delivery angling away, pushed with the angle to covers.

LBW APPEAL STRAIGHTAWAY! Angling outside off, Roy gets a long way across and pads it away. Nehra is appealing his heart out but the umpire is unmoved. He is dead right as the impact was way outside off. Don't know why Nehra is unhappy with the decision.
We are back for the chase! JASON ROY and SAM BILLINGS are the two who have come out to open. ASHISH NEHRA to begin the proceedings. 203 needed for the victory, entertainment is guaranteed!
